- **Artifact hosting:** Tangled Git tags + zero-egress object store (`SHA256SUMS` + standardized archive names).

Resolves #11.

### Summary
- **Dependencies:** Gate `notify`'s `macos_fsevent` feature to `cfg(target_os = "macos")` in `Cargo.toml`.
- **Platform Directories:** Add `PlatformDirs::resolve` with XDG Base Directory support (`$XDG_CONFIG_HOME`, `$XDG_CACHE_HOME`, `$XDG_STATE_HOME`) on Linux.
- **Volume & Snapshot Telemetry:** Add `LinuxVolumeTelemetry` using `libc::statvfs` + `/proc/mounts` (longest mount prefix + octal escape decoding) and `UnavailableSnapshotProvider`, exposing `platform`, `filesystem_type`, and `snapshots_supported` in `/api/health`, `/api/volume`, and `/api/snapshots`.
- **Filesystem Watcher:** Introduce `NativeFsWatcher` handling Linux `inotify` `ENOSPC` / `MaxFilesWatch` gracefully with a warning + `sysctl` guidance and falling back to periodic rescanning, plus mapping `Flag::Rescan` with empty paths (`IN_Q_OVERFLOW`) to the existing overflow/rescan path.
- **Service & UI:** Add `systemd --user` unit generation and lifecycle commands (`systemctl --user`) in `service`, `xdg-open` support for `--open`, and graceful non-macOS UI degradation in `web/`.

### Verification
- `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`, `cargo test` (36 unit + 2 E2E passed on macOS)
- `cd web && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build` (10 vitest tests passed)

Why: clients of the OpenAI-compatible proxy can send text and images but not audio. niri reaches gemini through this proxy and cannot hear a clip, even though albedo already carries audio to models that read it; an `input_audio` part was refused as an invalid message (400).

What:
- decode chat-completions `input_audio` parts (`format` wav or mp3), typed as an `AudioFormat`
- read the clip with `media_from_base64` and require it to be the container its format names
- pass it on as a clip beside any images in the user turn; audio is user-only, like images
- OpenAPI `ProxyAudioPart`, regenerated Go/TS clients, media.md note

Tested: proxy unit tests (decode, wrong-format refusal, user-only) 12 passed; `proxy_test.py` e2e 8/8, where an `input_audio` part reaches the upstream as `input_audio` with the same data; `test/quick.sh` ok.

From 1.20 release, we completely redesigned our old stacked PR model. Instead of mirroring each commits into PRs to make them individually reviewed, merged or abandoned, we just give way flexible diff model. Users can diff between arbitrary commits or interdiff between arbitrary versions. So technically "stacked PR" is gone. Commits are already stacked and giving well-designed interface to view & review it solves most of the scenarios.

But this still leave one limitation: [#216: We can't share same change between PRs.](https://tangled.org/tangled.org/core/issues/216)

Many stacked PR implementations including GitHub solves this by literally stacking PRs, creating dependency graph, letting each branches to *depend* (*be stacked*) on others. Apart from the fact that we can't really follow same solution because tangled PRs are detached from their source branch by design, I also think that isn't really good way to do this. We already have commit DAG. Building similar DAG between branches on top of that makes everything hard to understand and super complicated.

Instead, we can literally share changes between PRs and make that clear. Same direction we took for 1.20 PR system redesign; expose internal model clearly with fine interface.

To achieve this, we should show these informations on PR page:

- On commit row: other PRs including this commit in their latest submission range
- On commit row: whether this commit is already merged into target branch (related: [#4734](https://tangled.org/tangled.org/core/issues/4734))
- On discussion section: comments made from other PR but pinned to same jj-change

This needs some UI research before we proceed. I'm not sure if it's possible to build such interface and if it really solves the problem at all.

title.text: Track commits across PRs by change-id (tangled stacked PR)
